basis: Verified from current authoritative primary pages, narrowly compared to named CPL resources

records.dateMeaning: NICE NG225 publication date; guideline last reviewed 2024-08-16
records.claimChecked: Guideline recommends timely collaborative psychosocial assessment, concurrent medical assessment where feasible, individualized risk formulation, and not using risk scores to predict outcomes or decide discharge.
records.interpretation: CPL's assessment/formulation emphasis is directionally concordant; this is not a complete review of the pathway.
records.unresolved: UK guideline applicability in Arizona and institution-specific emergency pathways, professional competence and all exact CPL claims remain unverified.

records.dateMeaning: No source page last-update date independently verified on 2026-11-12
records.claimChecked: NIMH ASQ is a brief free suicide screen with youth/adult and care-setting pathways; its toolkit targets medical patients aged 8+ and requires trained clinician brief suicide safety assessment after a positive screen.
records.interpretation: CPL indexes the official ASQ toolkit and distinguishes screening from diagnosis; it does not itself certify ASQ implementation.
records.unresolved: Confirm exact setting and age pathway, positive-screen workflow, clinical training, translations and local policy before use.

records.dateMeaning: Official translations page fetched 2026-11-12; webpage update date not independently recorded
records.claimChecked: VA provides downloadable staff-reviewed Spanish PCL-5, PC-PTSD-5 and LEC-5 translations and expressly states they have not been validated in published research; qualified professional use caveat remains.
records.interpretation: Repaired source pointers and outdated 'by request' access language only; no scoring or interpretation content changed.
records.unresolved: External access and precise measure versions may change; translation psychometrics, user comprehension and appropriateness still require clinical review.

records.owner: US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
records.dateMeaning: Published/reviewed page date visibly shown by CDC
records.claimChecked: CDC emphasizes modifiable risk, protective relationships, support, limiting access to lethal means and available crisis care; risk factors are not an individual prediction.
records.interpretation: Narrow thematic concordance with CPL's noncontractual safety-planning discussion; no comprehensive suicide clinical guidance approval.
records.unresolved: Crisis management, 988/911 decision thresholds, safety-plan licensing and jurisdictional protocols still require specialist and owner review.
